title: Mr. and Mrs. Bennet Discuss Mr. Bingley's Arrival and the Marriage Prospects of Their Daughters
summary: A lively dialogue between Mr. and Mrs. Bennet about the wealthy, single Mr. Bingley who has moved into the neighbourhood. Mrs. Bennet urges her husband to visit him for their daughters' sake, while he teases her about her own beauty and refuses to see any reason to call on a newcomer.

title: Section 2: Recap of the Story So Far and Picture-Based Prediction Activity
summary: A 'story so far' box summarises the Bennets' discussions, the ball where Jane captures Bingley's attention, and Elizabeth overhearing Darcy's comments. Students study the accompanying picture and predict what Bingley and Darcy might be discussing, then complete exercises in the Activity Book.

title: Mr. Darcy Refuses to Dance and Makes a Cutting Remark About Elizabeth
summary: At the ball, Bingley urges Darcy to dance, but Darcy declines, claiming he has no suitable partner. When Bingley suggests he dance with Elizabeth, Darcy coldly dismisses her as pleasant but not beautiful enough, leaving Elizabeth with a poor impression of him.

title: Section 3: The Story So Far – Bingley Sisters, Growing Romance, and Elizabeth's Visit to Netherfield
summary: A recap covering the morning-after-ball discussions, the developing romance between Bingley and Jane, Darcy's growing interest in Elizabeth, and Elizabeth's muddy walk to Netherfield to care for the ill Jane. Students read the summary, examine the picture, and complete related exercises.

title: Elizabeth Faces Cold Treatment at Netherfield While Caroline and Louisa Criticise Her Behind Her Back
summary: At a Netherfield dinner, only Mr. Bingley shows Elizabeth any warmth; Caroline and Louisa ignore her. Once Elizabeth leaves to check on Jane, the sisters mock her manners, untidy appearance, and muddy petticoat, expressing open disdain for her.

title: Section 4: The Story So Far – Mr Collins's Visit and Elizabeth's Meeting with Mr Wickham
summary: A recap covering Mrs Bennet's embarrassing visit to Netherfield, Mr Collins's arrival and interest in Elizabeth, and her introduction to military men Mr Denny and Mr Wickham. Students study the picture, predict Elizabeth's shock, and complete exercises in the Activity Book.

title: Mr. Wickham Explains to Elizabeth How Mr. Darcy Denied Him His Inheritance
summary: Wickham tells Elizabeth that his godfather, the late Mr. Darcy, intended to provide for him, but the son disputed the bequest due to a legal informality. He claims he lost the inheritance through no fault of his own and that Darcy simply hates him, leaving Elizabeth shocked.

title: Section 5: The Story So Far – Collins's Proposal, Wickham's Shift, and Darcy's Secret Intervention
summary: A recap covering the Netherfield ball, Collins's rejected proposal to Elizabeth, Bingley's departure to London, Wickham's pursuit of Miss King, and Elizabeth's discovery that Darcy may have prevented a friend from marrying the wrong person.
